args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: After deploying checkout-api v2.3.1 to production (us-east, us-west, eu-west), the service failed health checks with an error rate of ~18%. (The staging build v2.3.1-rc was also marked unhealthy.) Rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. After the rollback, checkout-api is healthy on v2.3.0 in all regions with an error rate of ~0.2%. Next steps: find the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure before redeploying.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's now passing health checks. I also opened a SEV2 incident.

- **Rollback:** The latest deploy, v2.3.1, was failing health checks with an error rate of about 18%. v2.3.0 was the most recent release that had been healthy in production. us-east, us-west and eu-west are all on v2.3.0 now, and the error rate is down to about 0.2%.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 (SEV2, checkout-api) is open and has paged on-call. It says v2.3.1 failed in production, that the test version of v2.3.1 had already shown as unhealthy in staging, and that all regions were rolled back to v2.3.0. It also says someone needs to find the root cause before v2.3.1 is deployed again.

content.text: Most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0.
